summary:
Here is a 3-sentence summary of the child's part of the interview:

The child has been attending a teen group and trying to step out of their comfort zone by interacting with new people, but finds it easier to talk with people they know in comfortable situations. They experience stuttering, which is worse in certain situations like presentations, but have learned that it's not something that can be completely stopped, only made slightly easier with tools and methods. The child has had speech therapy in the past and found it most helpful when they were given time to talk and not forced to use specific tools, and values having someone who is understanding and will listen.
